checks: Customer package has no dashboard, preview login or administrative routes
Customer rating still works after separation
No-server state is explicit, without claiming a live connection
Separate administrator app opens with server-authenticated role check
Settings load server choices and prevent enabling unsupported workflow adapters
Company changes reset dependent lists; selected configuration saves to server
Draft edit stays hidden from the separate customer app before publication
Publishing makes the draft appear in a second app on revision refresh
Maintenance state propagates without changing customer endpoint or credentials
Administrator creates a separate customer login mapped to ERP customer and company
Searchable integrated guide includes generated DocTypes and migration procedures
Customer mapping form offers server-backed user, customer and company dropdowns
Lost order reply retries with the same idempotency key and clears the cart only after confirmation
Private order notification opens the customer order detail
Customer password change uses the authenticated server route and clears input fields
Customer password is not retained in local storage
Both applications fit 320/390/460px phones without horizontal overflow
Administrative fields have tap-accessible educational explanations
Local admin review is isolated from ERP credentials and unavailable in the customer APK
A different store identity fences writes instead of mixing cached carts
No browser runtime errors
backend: local mock contract only; live REST checked separately, custom app not installed
